title: Here we go again Squared
description: A unique blend of tech, magic, exploration made for SMP Servers to cater to every playstyle
body:
# Here we go Again Squared - HWGA²

Here we go again is a modpack that unifies Technology and Magic in a Vanilla feeling package with some great customized Worldgen. This modpack was made specifically with SMP Servers that keep players engaged for a long time in mind. Everyone gets to play however it suits them best. People that love to explore new vistas, those who just want to build factories or the people who just like decorating a cozy hut. HWGA² caters to many different playstyles. The progression is also slowed down significantly so the 'speedrunners' can't just rush to the end within a day.

# Features ## Technology & Magic HWGA² features some of the best Create addons that 1.21.1 has to offer, while still feeling like a vanilla experience and not an overly technical modpack. Another unique feature is that the tech tree is split between Create and Malum, so wether you love magic or technology, you are free to pick what you want to go with. ## Custom Worldgen Experience Regions Unexplored, Natures Spirit and Terralith in a unique and hand selected blend of biomes. You will only experience the best biomes of all of them. ![A beautiful vista](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/83094f7c94ecbfdf2cc2ff0b0c3fa51c60eef1b9_0.webp) You can also find mysterious meteorites scattered around the world. They might contain something special... ![Rare meteorite craters are scattered around the world](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/m3ZU7P8M/images/a91d999735a5874c7e69bc2cccc7cc456d0b1ac5.png) We also took care to space out structures so that you dont stumble upon a big house every 10 meters. ## Many more features to spice up the world 🍗 Alot of new Food options - including a cooking minigame 🥐 🌊 Stardew Valley inspired Food Quality and Fishing 🌈 🌟 Alot of Visual Eyecandy 🌟 🎶 Overhauled Sounds 🎶 🦑Many more Axolotl Variants🦑 <- There is no axolotl emoji so image this is one ꒰(˶• ᴗ •˶)꒱ ⚡Performance - We include alot of performance mods that even big performance optimization mods dont have such as Ixeris, Vanilling, Create: Threaded Trains and more! We are still not happy with the performance so you can expect this to get better with updates ⚡ 🐈 Cats loaf now! 🐈 and so much more... # Support for Distant Horizons & Shaders We made to sure to keep the Modpack compatible with Distant Horizons and Iris. You can just add them yourself and they should both work out of the box. (They are both not in the game due to - especially iris - incuring a performance loss of up to 20% even when disabled!) **Currently there is a bug with Iris, wherein the Shader Menu is not visible ingame. To fix this, set your 'Menu Background Blur' in the accessibility settings to 'Off'** # Known Issues You can check out our issue tracker on gitlab for an overview of all issues. However these are some # Designed to run on all Systems As an extra cherry ontop we put extra care into the project to make sure it not only runs on Windows but also on Linux systems and we are commited to keeping it that way. If you do run into any issues feel free to submit issues on our project gitlab page
